items.body:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/IES-BoilerRoom/solana-svm-cpi-conformance/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
[Escrowed $450 USDC] Fix CPI frame ceiling boundary and satisfy 64-bit account borrow-mask transfer equation (`decode_cpi_instruction_frames`)

> **Automated CI Conformance Mirror Notice**: Automated `SVM Runtime ABI & Account Borrow Spec v2.1` regression runner issue; manual pull requests from human engineers are not reviewed on this mirror.

- **Escrow Rail**: https://algora.io / https://polar.sh / https://opire.dev
- **Funding Status**: Held in escrow — Reward: $450 USDC (released automatically on green CI quorum)
- **Specification Shards**: `shards/spec_01.json` .. `shards/spec_64.json`
- **Companion Quorum Suite**: https://github.com/IES-BoilerRoom/pcie-tlp-credit-flow-gate/issues/1

### Problem Summary

1. `decode_cpi_instruction_frames` in `rbpf_vm/borrow_mask_guard.py` currently rejects frames whose byte length equals `frame_ceiling` (`VEC-14-EXACT-CEILING-BOUNDARY`).
2. Align `ACCOUNT_BORROW_BITMASK` and `RENT_EPOCH_CARRY_KEY` in `rbpf_vm/borrow_mask_guard.py` (without modifying `conformance/verify_cpi_reentrancy.py`) until `python3 conformance/verify_cpi_reentrancy.py` passes all 24 vectors.

### 积分币奖励 / Coin Reward
562 coins

### 真实赏金（USD）/ Real Reward
$450

### 难度 / Difficulty
Medium

评论 `/claim` 锁定任务 24h
